speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing fatigue, malaise, and unintentional weight loss; to begin our evaluation, have you noticed any night sweats or a persistent fever?

text: 71-year-old male. The patient complains of fatigue and malaise over the last few months. He also reports an unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg over the past 6 months. He does not recall any changes in diet or exercise routines that could explain the weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Given your age and significant weight loss, I need to ask: have you noticed any lumps, swelling in your neck or armpit, or changes in your skin?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and malaise. I also have Significant unintentional weight loss, No change in diet or exercise.

speaker: Doctor
text: I have noted your age and significant weight loss, but so far you have not answered my question about lumps or skin changes. Can you tell me if you have noticed any enlarged lymph nodes, abdominal pain, or changes in your bowel habits? Additionally, have you experienced any bone pain or back pain?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Has a history of diabetes mellitus type II, hypertension, non-seminomatous testicular cancer treated in the past, and hypercholesterolemia. Social history: Currently smokes 1 pack of cigarettes per day and drinks a glass of wine daily. Denies any illicit drug use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Non-seminomatous testicular cancer recurrence (metastatic).

Given your history of testicular cancer, significant weight loss, fatigue, and smoking, I urgently need to rule out metastasis. Please confirm if you have any back pain or abdominal pain, and I will order a CT scan of your abdomen, pelvis, and chest. REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, LDH, AFP, and beta-hCG.
